title: Add retry budget to outbound webhooks
author: priya
body: Webhooks now retry up to 5 times with exponential backoff and give up with a dead-letter event instead of retrying forever.
mock_summary: Webhooks retry up to 5 times with backoff, then land in a dead-letter queue instead of retrying forever.

title: Dark mode for the dashboard
author: marco
body: Adds a theme toggle in settings. Respects the OS preference by default. All charts re-tuned for contrast.
mock_summary: The dashboard has a dark mode that follows your OS setting, with charts re-tuned for contrast.

title: Fix CSV export dropping rows over 10k
author: aiko
body: The export streamed into a fixed buffer and silently truncated at 10,000 rows. Now streams to the response.
mock_summary: CSV exports no longer stop at 10,000 rows; large exports stream in full.

title: SSO: support Okta SCIM provisioning
author: priya
body: Users and groups created in Okta are provisioned automatically. Deprovisioning revokes sessions within a minute.
mock_summary: Okta SCIM provisioning creates users and groups automatically, and removing a user revokes their sessions within a minute.

title: Cut cold-start latency by 40%
author: marco
body: Lazy-load the analytics bundle and precompute the route manifest at build time. p50 cold start 1.9s -> 1.1s.
mock_summary: Cold starts are about 40% faster (p50 1.9s to 1.1s) thanks to lazy loading and a precomputed route manifest.

title: Deprecate v1 search endpoint
author: aiko
body: GET /v1/search now returns a Deprecation header. It will be removed in v1.6. Use /v2/search.
mock_summary: The v1 search endpoint is deprecated and will be removed in v1.6; move to /v2/search.
